name: supertonic3-tts-german-wyoming
description: Local German text-to-speech for Home Assistant using Supertonic 3, native Wyoming integration and an optimized Rust/ONNX Runtime backend. Optimized and tested on Intel N100. Includes 10 voices, custom voice support, German text normalization and low-latency phrase streaming. First start downloads missing models and voices into the persistent folders. Existing files remain available after updates. Streaming is optional; turn it off for full-text synthesis. Audio is 44100 Hz, mono PCM16. Connect Home Assistant to the Wyoming port; HTTP provides health and voice information. Before installation, choose unused host ports and ensure both folders are writable by UID/GID 99:100.

paths.name: Models
paths.description: Persistent model storage. Only missing files download. Folder must be writable by UID/GID 99:100.

paths.name: Voices
paths.description: Persistent standard and custom voices. Add compatible JSON files here and restart. Folder must be writable by UID/GID 99:100.

ports.name: Wyoming Port
ports.description: Free host TCP port for the Home Assistant Wyoming integration. Container port normally stays 10200.

ports.name: HTTP Port
ports.description: Free host TCP port for health and voice information. This is not the Home Assistant Wyoming port.

variables.name: Default Voice
variables.description: Choose F1–F5, M1–M5, or the filename of an installed custom JSON voice without .json.

variables.name: Language
variables.description: Language code for synthesis. German (de) is the default; Supertonic 3 supports 31 languages. See the README for all supported language codes. For non-German input, disable German Normalization.

variables.name: Speed
variables.description: Speaking speed: 1.0 is normal; smaller values are slower. Allowed range 0.25–4.0.

variables.name: Steps
variables.description: Speech generation steps, 5–12. Recommended Intel N100 setting: 6. More steps require more time.

variables.name: Threads
variables.description: CPU threads used for speech generation. Recommended for Intel N100: 4.

variables.name: German Normalization
variables.description: Read German numbers, temperatures, times and units naturally. Set false to disable.

variables.name: Streaming
variables.description: Start sending completed phrases early. Set false for complete-text synthesis. Actual playback timing also depends on Home Assistant.

variables.name: Streaming Prefill (ms)
variables.description: Audio to prepare before sending the first block. Recommended: 3500 milliseconds. Allowed: 0–5000.

variables.name: Concurrent Requests
variables.description: Simultaneous speech requests. Recommended: 1. Larger values use more memory.

variables.name: Model Directory
variables.description: Keep aligned with persistent container model path

variables.name: Voice Directory
variables.description: Keep aligned with persistent container voice path

variables.name: ORT Configured
variables.description: Preserve upstream engine unless deliberately tuning

variables.name: ORT Thread Pool
variables.description: global or session; legacy wrapper requires global

variables.name: ORT Inter-op Threads
variables.description: ONNX inter-op threads

variables.name: ORT Spinning
variables.description: Keep disabled for tested N100 configuration

variables.name: ORT Execution Mode
variables.description: parallel requires ORT_CONFIGURED=true

variables.name: Optimized Datapath
variables.description: Bounded audio conversion and output

variables.name: Buffered TCP
variables.description: Buffered writes and TCP_NODELAY

variables.name: AudioChunk Bytes
variables.description: Even value from 512 to 262144

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Rust tracing filter

variables.name: Container Wyoming Port
variables.description: Match internal target of the Wyoming port mapping

variables.name: Container HTTP Port
variables.description: Match internal target of the HTTP port mapping
